name: Bird Dog
cues: Set your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back
Keep your hips level as if balancing a cup on your lower back
Pause at full reach, then bring the elbow and knee back under you

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Contralateral: right arm to 168 deg, left hip to -18 deg extension with the knee at 4 deg. The whole leg ends ~10 deg above horizontal (heel 0.66 m vs hip ~0.45 m). Lumbar and pelvis are fixed (hips level), support hands are flat on the mat, the reach hand is open, and the lower back shows from the az -65 camera.
